summary: Adult male kayaker reported missing at Lon Hagler Reservoir; body recovered Wednesday evening by the CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team with the Larimer County Sheriff’s Office, Larimer County SAR, county Emergency Services and parks, Loveland Fire Rescue and Poudre Fire Authority; victim apparently not wearing a life jacket
responding_agency: CPW Marine Evidence Recovery Team; LCSO; Larimer County SAR
notes: DATE APPROXIMATE: article text says "Wednesday evening" with no calendar date; dated 2024-06-26 from the page "last updated" metadata (~807 days before 2026-09-12 = 2024-06-27, a Thursday) - the preceding Wednesday. [run 933] LCSO release names full responder set (deputies, Loveland Fire Rescue Authority drone operators, CPW, Poudre Fire Authority, Larimer County SAR); vehicle at north parking lot; kayak recovered on shore late Tuesday by recreator who took it home; no PFD found.
